Load one of four example uniformity trials

Source: R/matrix_input.R
example_trial.Rd

Loads one of four uniformity trials carried out in Guanacaste, Costa Rica: rice and maize (20 rows x 20 columns of basic units), Nambi common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) and cowpea (Vigna unguiculata) (10 rows x 20 columns). Each basic unit measures 1 m x 1 m and each cell holds its yield.

Usage

example_trial(crop = c("rice", "maize", "common_bean", "cowpea"))

Source

The CSV files in inst/extdata; see data-raw/README.md in the package source for their provenance.

Arguments

crop

One of "rice", "maize", "common_bean" or "cowpea".

Value

A numeric yield matrix whose rows and columns are the rows and columns of the field.

Examples

dim(example_trial("rice"))
#> [1] 20 20
